title: Zuriel Bible Book Introductions and Study Pathways
description: A structured companion for all 66 books of the Bible. Includes concise introductions and a distinct guided study pathway for every book. These are original study aids, not Bible text or a substitute for reading the passages in context.
editorialPolicy: All 66 canonical books are represented once in each collection.
References are prompts for reading the Bible text; no copyrighted translation text is reproduced.
Historical and theological summaries are concise orientation, not exhaustive scholarly conclusions.
Applications must follow the passage's meaning and original setting; avoid treating narrative description as automatic command or promise.
Cross-references are study trails and should be read in their own contexts.
Each book introduction includes a book-specific reading note; readers should follow the book's literary form, historical setting, and argument rather than apply isolated lines without context.

bookIntroductions.readingNote: Follow the movement from creation and human fracture to covenant promise. Notice repeated family patterns, divine initiative, and how blessing is meant to reach the nations.
